queries_run: Talen Energy TLN market share new entrants competition PJM 2026
Talen Energy data center deal competitor Constellation Vistra 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱競爭受新進入者、新建電廠、補貼等影響；PJM 為競爭市場，部分州考慮重新管制，可能限縮競爭供應商機會。
findings.excerpt: Competition is affected by electricity and fuel prices, grid congestion, government subsidies for new and certain existing generation facilities (including some which might otherwise retire), new market entrants, construction of new generation assets, technological advances in power generation, environmental and regulatory matters, and various other factors.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：競爭對手可能擁有更多資源、較新機組或較低成本；州或聯邦干預（補貼、公用事業電廠納入費率基礎）可能壓低容量與能源價格。
findings.excerpt: Some of our competitors may have advantages over us through access to greater resources, newer generation facilities, lower costs, or more experience.

findings.claim: PJM 市場監視者稱 Talen 收購 ECP 2.6GW 後控制約 13.1GW、為 PJM 第四大容量持有者；Constellation 收購 Calpine、Vistra 擬收購 Cogentrix，同業亦在擴張（摘自搜尋彙整，未讀原頁）。
findings.source: Utility Dive via Yahoo Finance: Reject Talen-Energy Capital power plant deal, PJM market monitor tells FERC

competitive_share_entrants.note: 未找到權威 2026 PJM 份額消長數據；CSIMarket 的 28.93% 營收份額估計方法不明，未採用。
